name: DaxLib.SVG.Element.Ellipse

parameters.name: cx
parameters.description: The x position of the center

parameters.name: cy
parameters.description: The y position of the center

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional: Direct SVG attributes to apply (e.g., "fill='none' stroke='blue'"), can generate with `DaxLib.SVG.Attr.*` or manually

parameters.name: transforms
parameters.description: Optional: Transformation to apply (can be generated with `DaxLib.SVG.Transforms`)

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Element.Ellipse' =
		(
			cx: STRING,
			cy: STRING,
			rx: STRING,
			ry: STRING,
			attributes: STRING = BLANK(),
			transforms: STRING = BLANK()
		) =>

			"<ellipse" &
			" cx='" & cx & "'" &
			" cy='" & cy & "'" &
			" rx='" & rx & "'" &
			" ry='" & ry & "'" &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( attributes ), " " & attributes & " " ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( transforms ), " transform='" & transforms & "'" ) & 
			"/>"
